title: JOYOR S8-S-Z Dual-motor Electric Scooter
sellingPoints: Waterproof design, suitable for all-terrain riding

details.title: Simple and exquisite
details.content: The S8-S-Z is made of solid aluminum material, which has excellent thermal conductivity and corrosion resistance, and is durable. The appearance design is simple and exquisite, and the components and accessories adopt the same geometric design language, putting usability and user experience first.

details.title: Easy to operate
details.content: The JOYOR S8-S-Z scooter features a clear LCD display, waterproof design for external battery charging, ergonomic handlebars with safety features, and precise controls for safe and convenient urban commuting.

details.title: 600W*2 brushless motor
details.content: JOYOR S8-S-Z electric scooter is equipped with 600W*2 dual motors, which can quickly accelerate and climb 35 degrees, and the maximum speed on different terrains can reach 55 km/h.

details.title: 48V 26 AH Battery
details.content: High-capacity 48V 26 AH rechargeable battery provides a long range of 70-80 km under certain conditions with a maximum load of 150kg. You can enjoy the freedom of long-distance riding.

details.title: Patented Rubber Suspension
details.content: JOYOR S8-S-Z scooter is equipped with a high-strength suspension system and a patented shock-absorbing mechanism to make the ride smoother. In addition, its front and rear dual hydraulic brake systems can provide efficient braking.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: The S8-S-Z electric scooter has an unfolded size of 1215*610*1230mm and a folded size of 1120*610*525mm. It weighs 28.9kg and is easy to transport and store. It is an ideal choice for commuting to school, work or short trips.

moreDetails.caption: The scooter features a smart LCD showing speed, mode, battery, and lighting.
Large beam headlights and warning taillights, supplemented by agile turn indicators, provide all-round lighting, fearless of the dark night.
Front and rear disc brakes provide stable braking performance even at high speeds
The scooter is equipped with 10-inch pneumatic tires to ensure a smooth, shock-absorbing ride on bumpy roads.
